import pytest
from isort.api import check_stream
from io import StringIO

def test_check_stream_valid_imports():
    input_stream = StringIO("import os\nimport sys\n\n")
    assert check_stream(input_stream, show_diff=False, file_path='test_file.py') == True

def test_check_stream_invalid_imports():
    input_stream = StringIO("import sys\nimport os\n\nimport math\n\n")
    assert check_stream(input_stream, show_diff=True, file_path='test_file_invalid.py') == False

def test_check_stream_with_diff_output():
    input_stream = StringIO("import os\nimport sys\nimport random\n\n")
    # Assuming the function's diff output behavior is appropriately tested
    assert check_stream(input_stream, show_diff='diff_output.txt', file_path='test_file_diff.py') == False

def test_check_stream_empty_input():
    input_stream = StringIO("")
    assert check_stream(input_stream, show_diff=False, file_path='test_empty_file.py') == True

def test_check_stream_ignore_skip():
    input_stream = StringIO("import os\n\n")
    assert check_stream(input_stream, disregard_skip=True, show_diff=False, file_path='test_file_skip.py') == True
